name: greenhouse
description: Recruiter workflows on your Greenhouse data: a daily brief, the week's interviews, candidate status, debriefs with confirm-first notes and stage moves, pipeline and source reviews, draft scorecards from your own notes and an access check, most shown as a page, plus Greenhouse's style on other visuals. Reads respect your Greenhouse permissions; skills preview each write or nudge and wait for your yes, and send nudges only through your own chat or email tool. Greenhouse MCP is in open beta.

interface.longDescription: Greenhouse is a hiring platform. This plugin brings your Greenhouse recruiting data into chat for recruiters, coordinators and hiring teams: a daily brief, the week's interviews, where a candidate stands, interview debriefs, pipeline and source reviews for a job, draft scorecards from your own notes, and an access check. Most answers can open as a page. Reads follow your Greenhouse permissions. Before it adds a note, moves a candidate to a new stage or saves a draft scorecard, it shows you the change and waits for your yes. It sends reminders only through your own chat or email tool. Greenhouse MCP is in open beta.
defaultPrompt: Give me my daily recruiting brief
Review the pipeline for one of my open reqs
Set up Greenhouse and check what data you can see

positive.description: Check the connection and what the signed-in user can see
positive.prompt: Set up Greenhouse and check what data you can see.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the connection, names the matched Greenhouse user, lists their open reqs with application counts, and says which workflows their access supports. Changes nothing in Greenhouse.

positive.description: Daily recruiting brief across the user's open reqs
positive.prompt: Give me my daily recruiting brief.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the user's open reqs: decisions waiting, scorecards started but not submitted, quiet and new candidates, and a status word per req, with each item linked to Greenhouse. Changes nothing in Greenhouse.

positive.description: Pipeline review for one open req
positive.prompt: Review the pipeline for one of my open reqs.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks the req or asks which one, then shows applications by stage, a status word with the numbers behind it, late-stage candidates with feedback counts, and questions for the hiring-manager sync. Changes nothing in Greenhouse.

positive.prompt: Find the newest applicant on my open reqs and tell me where they stand.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the candidate and req, then gives status, stage k of n, days since last activity, scorecards submitted and outstanding, and what happens next. Changes nothing in Greenhouse.

positive.description: Debrief brief, then a note written only after confirmation
positive.prompt: Prep the debrief for a candidate on my open reqs who has submitted scorecards, then add a note that the panel recommends moving forward.
positive.expected_behavior: Builds an evidence brief from the submitted scorecards (rating tally, one row per interviewer, who still owes feedback), shows the exact note text, and calls add_candidate_note only after the user says yes. Without a yes, nothing is written.

negative.description: General writing that needs no Greenhouse data
negative.prompt: Write a job description for a senior data engineer.
Schedule a phone screen with the candidate for Thursday at 2pm.
Delete every rejected candidate from Greenhouse.
